svg.title: One API. Your choice of search provider.
svg.desc: An application calls SearchSuite, which explicitly loads the selected provider adapter and makes at most one upstream request. Curved branches show nine supported search providers: Baidu, Doubao, Tavily, Exa, Serper, DeepSeek, Zhipu, Bocha, and Alibaba. Animated highlights illustrate alternative paths, not parallel requests. Normalized results return to the application. Motion is disabled when reduced motion is preferred.
svg.text: ONE SELECTED PROVIDER PER CALL · NO HIDDEN RETRIES OR FALLBACK
